name: Alistair Humphrey
bio:
Alistair Humphrey's journey into motorsport began in the late 1980s, volunteering at Silverstone during Formula 1 weekends. He quickly moved up the ranks, starting as a data analyst for a small Formula Ford team before transitioning into management. His sharp eye for detail and ability to see the bigger picture led him to sporting director roles in various racing series. Alistair emphasizes a collaborative environment, fostering open communication between engineers, drivers, and the pit crew. 

Known for his calm demeanor under pressure, Alistair is adept at making strategic decisions in the heat of the race. He is particularly skilled at identifying emerging talent and nurturing their potential, often taking calculated risks on young drivers with raw skill. Alistair is a firm believer in data-driven decisions, constantly seeking innovative ways to improve performance and gain a competitive edge for the team. His distinctive approach lies in his ability to balance technical expertise with effective team management, creating a cohesive and high-performing unit.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Alistair is a man of medium build with a distinguished air about him.

quirks: Always carries a worn copy of 'Art of War' and references it in meetings.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having Earl Grey tea, prepared with a specific water temperature, before every race.
